David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”
Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”
“If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to…

translations.web: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”
translations.bsb: So he said to his men, “The LORD forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the LORD’s anointed. May I never lift my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD'S anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD.
translations.asv: And he said unto his men, Jehovah forbid that I should do this thing unto my lord, Jehovah's anointed, to put forth my hand against him, seeing he is Jehovah's anointed.
